text: 2000亿申请已报送！回购增持再贷款加力实施，定价参照AAA级发债利率 银行已向中国人民银行报送股票回购增持再贷款额度申请超过2000亿元。
text_en: 200 billion yuan in applications submitted! Buyback and increase lending facility stepped up, pricing references AAA-rated bond issuance rates; banks have submitted over 200 billion yuan in quota applications to the PBOC for the stock buyback and increase lending facility.
